# Coursed

> Coursed is restaurant software that reads a venue's point-of-sale order feed and
> turns it into a live, per-table view of how well each table is being served —
> so a manager can fix a slipping table while the guests are still in the building.

Coursed is NOT a training platform, a course-builder, an e-learning product, or a
reservation system. The name refers to coursed dining service — the rhythm in which
courses reach a table.

Coursed reads POS order data only. It is read-only: it never writes to the POS,
never touches payments or card data, and never changes prices, menus or tickets.
Servers do not interact with it and their workflow does not change. Access can be
revoked at any time from the restaurant's own POS account.

Built and run by restaurant operators. Coursed runs live in the founders' own two
restaurants — Wye Hill Kitchen & Brewing in downtown Raleigh, NC, and Glasshouse
Kitchen in Research Triangle Park, NC.

- Category: restaurant management software / front-of-house service operations
- POS supported: Toast (read-only integration); others on request
- Pricing: $199-249 per location per month
- Trial: 30-day assisted pilot, no card required before setup
- Contact: support@getcoursed.com

## Core pages

- [Home](https://getcoursed.com/): What Coursed is — the live service board, the six-step service ladder, and how it works.
- [Coursed for Toast](https://getcoursed.com/toast): How the read-only Toast integration works, what it reads, and what it never does.
- [Pricing](https://getcoursed.com/pricing): One plan per location. Board, Pace alerts, history, coaching and reporting included.
- [FAQ](https://getcoursed.com/faq): POS support, connection method, data handling, security, pricing and pilot terms.
- [Getting started](https://getcoursed.com/getting-started): Setup, onboarding and first shift on the board.

## Writing

- [How to read the board](https://getcoursed.com/blog/how-to-read-the-board): The six-step service ladder, card anatomy, and what to do about each flag.
